content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IIT Jammu Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download IIT Jammu Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For Junior Research Fellow (JRF): M.E./M.Tech./M.S. (Research) or equivalent in CSE/IT/Mathematics & Computing (60% marks) OR B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc./MCA in CSE/CS/Mathematics (80% marks) with valid GATE (for B.E./B.Tech.); 5% relaxation for SC/ST/PwD/EWS/OBC-NCL. For Project Assistant: M.E./M.Tech./M.S. (Research) or equivalent in CSE/IT/Mathematics & Computing (60% marks) OR B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc./MCA in CSE/CS/Mathematics (80% marks) with valid GATE (for B.E./B.Tech.); 5% relaxation for SC/ST/PwD/EWS/OBC-NCL.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for all posts is 28 years. Age relaxation: 3 years for SC/ST/women/PwD; 2 years for OBC (NCL).

content_sections.heading: Salary/ Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): ₹37,000/- per month + HRA (for the first 18 months); ₹42,000/- per month (from year 3, no HRA). Project Assistant: ₹27,000/- per month (no HRA).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Jammu Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Jammu to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Assistant posts is 12 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Project Assistant posts in the IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026. This includes 1 post for JRF and 1 for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Assistant posts is Online. Interested and eligible candidates must apply through the official website of IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Assistant positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Assistant positions at IIT Jammu is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: The salary for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is ₹37,000/- per month + HRA for the first 18 months, increasing to ₹42,000/- per month from the third year (without HRA).

faq.question: Q6. What are the qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.E./M.Tech./M.S. (Research) or equivalent in CSE/IT/Mathematics & Computing (60% marks) OR B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc./MCA in CSE/CS/Mathematics (80% marks) with a valid GATE score (for B.E./B.Tech.).

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the IIT Jammu recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Assistant recruitment. Candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Assistant posts at IIT Jammu includes a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages for selection.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF for IIT Jammu recruitment can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all detailed information regarding the vacancies and application process.
